newsitem.title: CHINA: Soccer-Wang's hat-trick sees Dalian past Guangdong.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Wang's hat-trick sees Dalian past Guangdong.

text.p: Dalian Wanda's Wang Tao scored a hat-trick as his side edged out Guangdong Hongyuan 3-2 and maintained top spot in China's professional soccer league, Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Visitors Hongyuan scored first after 10 minutes but Wang answered with two goals in five minutes which saw Dalian lead 2-1 at the break.
Yao Debiao pulled the Guangdong side level in the 49th minute, but the towering Wang broke the deadlock with a goal in injury time.
Unbeaten Dalian have 39 points from 11 wins and six draws.

In other matches on Sunday, defending champions Shanghai Shenhua edged Yanbian Hyundai 1-0 at home, Beijing Guo'an stopped Guangzhou Apollo 1-0, the Chinese Army blanked Guangzhou Songri 2-0, and Jinan Taishan nipped Tianjin Sangsung 1-0.
